description: field-sizing: content as Chromium 153 lays it out: text inputs (a placeholder-only one with min- and max-width, an email input with a value) and text areas (empty, a placeholder wrapped at a percentage width with a min-height, rows and cols ignored under a max-width, a max-height with hidden overflow, a min-width and min-height) are sized by their text, or their placeholder while that is shown; typing grows them (the name input up to its max-width, then scrolled to the caret) and deleting shrinks them, and a class switch to field-sizing: fixed gives the text area its rows and cols size again. The text following each control shows its width
